offering_description.value: Owns and operates outpatient diagnostic imaging centers providing MRI, CT, PET/CT, mammography, ultrasound and X-ray services to patients referred by physicians. Also develops AI software for image analysis and breast cancer detection, and offers digital health tools.

primary_products.value: AI-based imaging analysis software; digital health applications

primary_services.value: outpatient diagnostic imaging (MRI, CT, PET/CT); breast imaging and mammography; ultrasound and X-ray; radiology reading services

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients referred for imaging, including self-pay and screening patients; B2B: health plans, hospital systems and physician groups under contracts and joint ventures

end_markets.value: healthcare; outpatient diagnostic imaging; radiology; preventive screening

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: fees for imaging procedures paid by commercial insurers, Medicare and Medicaid; service fees: self-pay imaging and capitated contract payments from health plans; subscription: AI software offered to clinicians and consumers

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs imaging centers with scanners, serving patients referred by physicians; service provider: radiologists interpret studies for patients, hospitals and health plans; software / platform: develops AI imaging software sold to providers and patients
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: US regional: Centers concentrated in California, New York, New Jersey, Maryland, Florida, Delaware and other states

specialization.value: related lines: imaging centers, radiology services and AI/digital health software

distribution_channels.value: own locations: owned and joint venture outpatient imaging centers; agents / brokers: physician referrals and health plan network contracts; online: direct patient scheduling and digital screening tools

regulatory_exposure.value: high: healthcare services reimbursed by Medicare/Medicaid, subject to CMS, HIPAA, state licensing, Stark and anti-kickback laws
